Cyberark Software LTD (CYBR) Shareholder Brown Capital Management Has Increased Stake by $483,472; Greenwich Investment Management Has Trimmed Ares Cap (ARCC) Stake by $4.48 Million as Market Valuation Declined 
March 21, 2018 - By Ruchi Gupta 
Brown Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Cyberark Software Ltd (CYBR) by 30.28% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Brown Capital Management Llc bought 11,792 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.21% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 50,731 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.08 million, up from 38,939 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Brown Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Cyberark Software Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.83B market cap company. The stock increased 0.25% or $0.13   $51.54. About 186,221 shares traded. CyberArk Software Ltd. (NASDAQ:CYBR) has risen 9.69% since March 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.01% the S&P500. 
Greenwich Investment Management Inc decreased its stake in Ares Cap Corp (ARCC) by 55.89% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Greenwich Investment Management Inc sold 279,754 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.68% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 220,813 shares of the company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $3.62M, down from 500,567 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greenwich Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Ares Cap Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $6.53B market cap company. The stock increased 0.46% or $0.07   $15.32. About 1.65M shares traded. Ares Capital Corporation (NASDAQ:ARCC) has risen 9.72% since March 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.98% the S&P500. 
Brown Capital Management Llc, which manages about $7.02 billion and $8.22 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Blackbaud Inc (NASDAQ:BLKB) by 62,859 shares to 4.89M shares, valued at $429.44M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Cognex Corp (NASDAQ:CGNX) by 821,414 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 4.01M shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
